Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the Union of India,
learned counsel for the National Highways Authority of India and learned counsel for the State.
2. The present writ petition has been filed for enhancement of compensation amount which has been prepared and the petitioner has received the same with objection.

3. Counsel for the petitioners submits that the Patna High Court CWJC No.11759 of 2023 dt.12-09-2023 petitioners are entitled to receive the compensation amount treating his land as residential whereas Award has been calculated treating his land as agricultural.

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the National Highways Authority of India submits that since the Award has already been prepared and the petitioners have accepted the Award with objection then in that case the liberty is available to the petitioners to file an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner.

5. In this view of the matter, the present writ petition is disposed of directing the petitioners to file a fresh representation along with a copy of this order before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner, Patna raising all his points within four weeks, who shall decide his representation within nine months thereafter.
